data.action: 仰头立于花帘下，花瓣落发，转身浅笑藏悲
data.camera: medium shot, wisteria canopy, petal light, bittersweet mood
data.description: 【藤园·满开午后】紫藤花帘垂落如瀑，忍站在花架下仰头让花影落在脸上。她忽然开口，声音轻得像花瓣——「紫藤花的毒对鬼致命……对我也一样哦。所以呐，在我还笑得出来的日子里……要一起看更多、更多的花才行。」转过身来，微笑之下第一次露出了真实的悲伤。
data.lighting: 紫藤花帘过滤的淡紫光
data.promptProse: Beneath a waterfall of blooming wisteria, Kochou Shinobu stands with her face lifted into the falling violet light, petals catching in her gradient hair. She speaks softly that the wisteria poison fatal to demons is fatal to her too, so while she can still smile, the two of you must come see many, many more flowers — and when she turns, the sadness beneath the smile shows itself for the first time. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed garden background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 紫藤花下的秘密·「紫藤花的毒，对鬼和对我都一样呢」
